test_title: PYST 26: SSC JE ME - Reasoning (Held on: 22 March 2021 (Morning)
subject: reasoning
question:
Choose the pair that best represents a similar relationship to the one expressed in the original pair of words.

Frequency : Hertz
solution: The Logic here is as follows: => S.I Unit of Frequency is Hertz. Similarly, ⇒ S.I Unit of **Heat** is **Joule.** Hence, the correct answer is "**Heat : Joule**". [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** * S.I Unit of Resistance is the Ohm. * S.I Unit of Energy is Joule. * S.I Unit of Volume is the Cubic meter. * S.I Unit of Force is Newton. * S.I Unit of Area is the Square meter. * S.I Unit of Temperature is Kelvin.
